description: Closed Stage 6 scenario vocabulary (docs/v2/stage6-design.md §19.6). Each Stage 6 case names exactly one scenario (a coverage item) and one archetype (its semantic family, eval/v2/spec/archetypes.json). archetypes lists the families a case of the scenario may use. expected_path describes the intended path in domain terms; the case labels (expected_action, expected_final_state) remain the normative expectation of each case.
